schema.sort_order: sources by source_id; role_results by family_id then source_role_id; claims by claim_id
schema.source_policy: First-party official issuer/operator pages only; planning URLs are leads and are not evidence until fetched.
schema.quote_policy: No verbatim quotation fields are used; evidence_locator identifies the fetched page section.

bounded_run.scope: Live first-party pages reachable from P0 planning leads and official linked pages, bounded to visible/reachable content during this run.
bounded_run.truncation: Dynamic directories and large issuer catalogs were recorded only as rendered/reachable in this run; child records requiring login or not rendered were not inferred. Card claims identify named SKUs where the official page did so and do not imply comprehensive SKU coverage.
bounded_run.fetch_policy: All admitted sources below were re-fetched as official pages during this run; no search snippet is used as claim evidence.

metadata.publisher_policy: Official pages from AEON, KDDI/au, NTT DOCOMO, Famima Digital One/FamilyMart, PayPay, Rakuten, PayPay Card, SMBC Card, and JR East/View Card were admitted.
metadata.pii_or_secret_check: No credentials, account data, tokens, payment data, or personal identifiers included.
